input.quote:
The exclusive remedy of either party in a claim against the other under this Agreement shall be the recovery of its direct damages. In no event shall either party be liable to the other for the recovery of any special, indirect or consequential damages even if the defendant party had been advised of the possibility of such damages including but not limited to lost profits, lost revenues, failure to realize expected savings, loss of data and loss of use. ... The limitation of liability in this Section 15 shall not apply to breaches of Sections 13 and 14.</quote>
<parameter name="rationale">Section 15 contains only a mutual exclusion of special, indirect and consequential damages and carves Sections 13 (IP indemnity) and 14 (confidentiality) out of that limitation. There is no aggregate monetary cap anywhere in the Agreement (no "exceed"/cap language elsewhere; "fees" are undefined and simply payable per the Fee Schedule), so each party's direct-damages exposure is unlimited and the fallback element of a mutual cap based on 12 months of fees fails, as do the gross negligence and wilful misconduct carve-outs (neither term appears in the document). The mutual indirect/consequential exclusion and the indemnification and confidentiality carve-outs are already in place, so the shortest cure is a single added sentence pair in Section 15 setting a mutual 12-month fees cap (which the existing "this Section 15" carve-out then automatically lifts for Sections 13 and 14) plus gross negligence and wilful misconduct. This lands the clause at the fallback position; we have not pursued the preferred greater-of USD 1,000,000 floor, data protection/security, fraud, IP-infringement carve-outs or the payment-obligations exclusion.

proposal.summary: Add a mutual 12-month fees liability cap in Section 15 plus gross negligence and wilful misconduct carve-outs
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 15 excludes indirect damages but sets no monetary cap, so both parties' direct-damages exposure is unlimited; we have added our fallback position of a mutual cap at 12 months' fees. Indemnification (Section 13) and confidentiality (Section 14) already sit outside Section 15's limitations, and we have added gross negligence and wilful misconduct to that carve-out.

ops.text: Each party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the fees paid or payable by Sparkling under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim. The limitations of liability in this Section 15 shall not apply to a party's gross negligence or wilful misconduct.
